plugins.description: A full multi-tab NomadNet browser for Reticulum -- tabs, address bar, back/forward/reload, favourites (shared with the Reticulum page's own Browse tab), raw/rendered view toggle, and keyboard shortcuts. Feature set and name inspired by fr33n0w's rBrowser (https://github.com/fr33n0w/rBrowser, MIT licensed) -- see README.md for full credit; this is a clean-room implementation built for Meshpoint's own plugin architecture, not a code port (rBrowser is a single-file Flask app, structurally very different from a Meshpoint sidebar plugin). Requires the reticulum plugin enabled.
plugins.author: Einstein PD2EMC
